body_v1.operation: Actual original visible terrain body surfaces plus42closed retained crowns. Three oriented-winding rays classify composite union; nearest actual face distance, bounded ordinary v4density replacement. No source stretching, new rock face source or runtime model overlay.

body_closed.operation: Actual original visible terrain body surfaces plus42closed retained crowns. Three oriented-winding rays classify composite union; nearest actual face distance, bounded ordinary v4density replacement. No source stretching, new rock face source or runtime model overlay. Before density conversion, Blender.10m voxel-remesh of the preserved composite source, with zero nonmanifold source edges required. Original flat upper cap ties belong to air. Closure alone is not art acceptance.

body_envelope.operation: Bounded vertical-envelope density of retained body/crown draw geometry. At each .25m XZ node, analytic float64 triangle intersections supply min/max Y; fill that entire interval, including visible air below overhangs. Nearest original face sets bounded magnitude. This is not a shape-preserving or exact CSG conversion. Outcrop props are excluded from the source and disappear in this unified study. Exact upper/lower ties belong to air. No new model or runtime overlay.

body_envelopecap.operation: Bounded vertical-envelope density of retained body/crown draw geometry. At each .25m XZ node, analytic float64 triangle intersections supply min/max Y; fill that entire interval, including visible air below overhangs. Nearest original face sets bounded magnitude. This is not a shape-preserving or exact CSG conversion. Outcrop props are excluded from the source and disappear in this unified study. Exact upper/lower ties belong to air. No new model or runtime overlay. Within .35m of a cap above a >.7m column, use vertical cap distance rather than nearest composite internal face, keeping the cap interpolation uniform.
